g.title: j1844692079
g.text: MomToxicated: And the time I took her out shopping for Vel's birthday.

g.title: j376104208
g.text: PapaPolar: 妮熙喜歡笑。

g.title: j716064277
g.text: PapaPolar: 邪惡？

g.title: j393165921
g.text: PapaPolar: 你送給我項鍊的那一年。

g.title: j1845067399
g.text: 我可以想像到那畫面。

g.title: j3107014397
g.text: 你是在開玩笑吧。

g.title: j2859054808
g.text: 對啊？

g.title: j3897353190
g.text: 這是你說的，不是我。

g.title: j1485563769
g.text: MomToxicated: And she got you the lighter.

g.title: j3107328262
g.text: PapaPolar: 好友，你覺得我為什麼要講這麼多故事？

g.title: j3253975935
g.text: PapaPolar: 確實很像她母親。不過她擁有多很多快樂。

g.title: j4156956692
g.text: MomToxicated: Nothing funnier than a little 12-year-old girl walking up to a counter, slapping a lighter onto a counter, and glaring at the man behind the desk.

g.title: j1182256668
g.text: PapaPolar: got into the habit with her. she loved to hear them. always would want to know about whatever M and i were up to

g.title: j56431440
g.text: MomToxicated: Before seriously demanding it be etched precisely the way SHE wanted it be done.

g.title: j3406088738
g.text: PapaPolar: but i'd tell her about This Thing or That Thing and So No Shit There We Were

g.title: j3614197716
g.text: Did she ever laugh as a kid? Like, a normal laugh. Not an evil laugh.

g.title: j541377550
g.text: I could picture that.

g.title: j2552646436
g.text: PapaPolar: and This Went SO WRONG

g.title: j1047964856
g.text: PapaPolar: you kidding me? all the time! neci loves to laugh.

g.title: j1238721594
g.text: PapaPolar: takes after her mother, sure. but there's also so much joy in that one.

g.title: j1265366746
g.text: PapaPolar: and she'd sit there and laaaaaugh and laaaugh

g.title: j2896472557
g.text: You're kidding me.

g.title: j2735389957
g.text: Oh? What does she find funny? (Please no more dad jokes.)

g.title: j329327495
g.text: PapaPolar: neci loves to laugh.

g.title: j2427033850
g.text: PapaPolar: nobody loves a good bad story quite like her

g.title: j498098544
g.text: MomToxicated: And we'd bring her back some little bric-a-brac. Never mattered what it was.

g.title: j1900382317
g.text: MomToxicated: But it was a piece of that story for her. A memory of it. And it was added to the collection.

g.title: j2591313244
g.text: MomToxicated: She might not have been there, but it was.
